about: Hand review of the mechanical score, applied the same way to every tool. The keyword rules in METHOD.md were fixed before any run; reading the matched findings showed some credits were wrong and some real finds were missed. Each change says why. Results show both the mechanical and the audited score.

changes.reason: Credited from the wrong-input email line, which shows the missing email check (B3), not the email being dropped on save. Nothing in this run checked what was saved.
Credited from a test-the-tests line saying no test runs renameProduct; that is about test coverage, not the UPDATE without WHERE.
Same as the automatic run: a coverage gap, not the mass update.
PMD's SimpleDateFormatNeedsLocale flags the missing locale on that line, not the shared static formatter's thread safety.
Mechanically credited from the HTTP email line (wrong evidence), but the spec macro members-form-keeps-email genuinely failed because the saved member had no email. Kept, with the right evidence.
S2885 ("Make STAMP an instance variable") is Sonar's rule that non-thread-safe fields must not be static; the message lacked the keywords.
S2676 ("Use the original value instead") is the rule against Math.abs on a value that can be MIN_VALUE, at the defect's line; the message lacked the keywords.

Mechanically credited from an anti-CSRF alert (wrong evidence), but ZAP's Integer Overflow alert sent memberId=000... to POST /orders and got HTTP 500: that is the missing-member crash. Kept, with the right evidence.
Credited from a missing Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy header alert whose instances include /api/products; nothing about the UPDATE without WHERE.
STCAL_INVOKE_ON_STATIC_DATE_FORMAT_INSTANCE reports the shared static formatter at the line where it is used rather than declared, so the line rule missed it.
